subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Which public contract should OpenClaw expose, if any, for disabling built-in skill source roots such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but the repair adds public `skills.load` configuration and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Add typed disabled sources
options.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list, default to current behavior, and skip disabled built-in roots before discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Narrow personal-source toggle
options.body: Add only a boolean opt-out for `~/.agents/skills`, reducing surface area but making future source controls less uniform.

options.title: Keep current model
options.body: Decline new config surface and document per-agent skill allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables as the supported controls.

recommendation.title: Add typed disabled sources
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list, default to current behavior, and skip disabled built-in roots before discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the watcher/config/docs side of the skills surface and is a practical owner for the API-shape decision.
